instruction: Select the cell with the greatest mark in the 'Marks' column and highlight it in yellow.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum mark (95.0 at row 13, cell C13) and highlighting it with background color. Verified with Python: max mark is 95.0 in cell C13. Custom getter extracts fill color info from C13, metric checks if cell has fill color applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both requirements - correct cell (C13 with max mark 95.0) and yellow background color
Correct getter logic: Extracts fill color information from cell C13 including fgColor RGB data
Robust metric logic: Checks both that fill exists AND that color is yellow using multiple validation methods (exact variant matching and RGB threshold checking)

Yellow color validation includes: (1) exact match against common yellow variants (FFFFFF00, FFFF00, FFFACD, etc.), (2) RGB threshold check (R>200, G>200, B<100) for yellow-like colors
